declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The local field algebra `J(T)` of a gauge-field datum, in which the local expressions
of the theory, such as Lagrangian terms, currents and field strengths, live before any of
them is selected. It is the exterior algebra of the fermionic generators tensored with
the symmetric algebra of the bosonic generators, tensored with the complexified symmetric
algebra of the connection generators.

All the fermionic species share one exterior algebra, so their generators anticommute
across species and not only within one. The factor order matches
`StandardModel.JetAlgebra`.
declarations.statement: abbrev LocalFieldAlgebra : Type

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeFermion
declarations.doc: The inclusion of the fermionic factor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def includeFermion :
    ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators →ₐ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeBoson
declarations.doc: The inclusion of the bosonic factor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def includeBoson :
    SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators →ₐ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeConnection
declarations.doc: The inclusion of the complexified connection factor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def includeConnection :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) →ₐ[ℂ]
      T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.MatterAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The matter factor of the local field algebra, on which the two matter inclusions
land.
declarations.statement: abbrev MatterAlgebra : Type

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.one_matterAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The unit of the matter factor is the tensor of the two units. It is recorded here, at
an abstract datum, because unfolding it at a concrete one has to see through the
symmetric algebra's ring congruence, which is not exposed, and is prohibitively slow.
declarations.statement:
lemma one_matterAlgebra :
    (1 : T.MatterAlgebra)
      = (1 : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        (1 : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeFermion_apply
declarations.doc:
The fermionic inclusion, written out as a pure tensor with units in the other two
factors. Recorded at an abstract datum for the same reason.
declarations.statement:
lemma includeFermion_apply (a : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators) :
    T.includeFermion a
      = ((a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators))
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
        T.LocalFieldAlgebra)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeBoson_apply
declarations.doc: The bosonic inclusion, written out as a pure tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma includeBoson_apply (b : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators) :
    T.includeBoson b
      = (((1 : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
        T.LocalFieldAlgebra)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeConnection_apply
declarations.doc: The connection inclusion, written out as a pure tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma includeConnection_apply
    (c : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    T.includeConnection c
      = ((1 : T.MatterAlgebra) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermionTotal
declarations.doc:
All the fermionic generators of the datum at once, the whole fermionic generator space
inside the algebra. Fermi statistics is a condition on this map, not on the species maps
separately.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ιFermionTotal : T.FermionGenerators →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBosonTotal
declarations.doc: All the bosonic generators of the datum at once.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ιBosonTotal : T.BosonGenerators →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιConnection
declarations.doc:
The connection generators inside the local field algebra. They are only real-linear,
the connection generator space being a real vector space, complexified inside the
algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def ιConnection :
    GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermion
declarations.doc: The generators of one fermionic species inside the local field algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def ιFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) :
    JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBoson
declarations.doc: The generators of one bosonic species inside the local field algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def ιBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) :
    JetComponentSpace (T.boson j) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermionTotal_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ιFermionTotal_apply (v : T.FermionGenerators) :
    T.ιFermionTotal v
      = (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ v ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators))
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤))

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBosonTotal_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBosonTotal_apply (v : T.BosonGenerators) :
    T.ιBosonTotal v
      = ((1 : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
            SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ T.BosonGenerators v)
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤))

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιConnection_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ιConnection_apply (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    T.ιConnection v
      = (1 : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators ⊗[ℂ] SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators)
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
            SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) v)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermion_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ιFermion_apply (i : T.FermionSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    T.ιFermion i x = T.ιFermionTotal (T.inclFermion i x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBoson_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBoson_apply (j : T.BosonSpecies) (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) :
    T.ιBoson j y = T.ιBosonTotal (T.inclBoson j y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermionTotal_mul_self
declarations.doc:
A fermionic generator squares to zero. This is Fermi statistics, in the form that
implies anticommutation across the whole fermionic generator space by polarization.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιFermionTotal_mul_self (v : T.FermionGenerators) :
    T.ιFermionTotal v * T.ιFermionTotal v = 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermionTotal_mul_swap
declarations.doc:
Two fermionic generators anticommute, including generators of two different species,
which share the one exterior algebra. This is not an extra relation, being
`ιFermionTotal_mul_self` polarized.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιFermionTotal_mul_swap (v w : T.FermionGenerators) :
    T.ιFermionTotal v * T.ιFermionTotal w = -(T.ιFermionTotal w * T.ιFermionTotal v)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBosonTotal_commute
declarations.doc: Two bosonic generators commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBosonTotal_commute (v w : T.BosonGenerators) :
    Commute (T.ιBosonTotal v) (T.ιBosonTotal w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιConnection_commute
declarations.doc: Two connection generators commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιConnection_commute (v w : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    Commute (T.ιConnection v) (T.ιConnection w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBosonTotal_commute_ιConnection
declarations.doc: A bosonic generator commutes with a connection generator.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBosonTotal_commute_ιConnection (v : T.BosonGenerators)
    (w : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    Commute (T.ιBosonTotal v) (T.ιConnection w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBosonTotal_commute_ιFermionTotal
declarations.doc: A bosonic generator commutes with a fermionic generator, bosons being even.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBosonTotal_commute_ιFermionTotal (v : T.BosonGenerators) (w : T.FermionGenerators) :
    Commute (T.ιBosonTotal v) (T.ιFermionTotal w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιConnection_commute_ιFermionTotal
declarations.doc:
A connection generator commutes with a fermionic generator, the connection being
even.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιConnection_commute_ιFermionTotal (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)
    (w : T.FermionGenerators) : Commute (T.ιConnection v) (T.ιFermionTotal w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.includeConnection_commute
declarations.doc:
The connection factor is central: its elements commute with the whole algebra, the
factor being commutative and tensored in as the right factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma includeConnection_commute
    (c : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) (x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) :
    Commute (T.includeConnection c) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermion_mul_self
declarations.doc: A fermionic generator of a species squares to zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιFermion_mul_self (i : T.FermionSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    T.ιFermion i x * T.ιFermion i x = 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιFermion_mul_swap
declarations.doc:
The generators of two fermionic species of the datum anticommute. The species enter
one exterior algebra through different summands of the fermionic generator space, so this
is ordinary exterior anticommutation and not an extra relation; it is what separate
exterior algebras joined by an ordinary tensor product would lose.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιFermion_mul_swap (i j : T.FermionSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i))
    (y : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion j)) :
    T.ιFermion i x * T.ιFermion j y = -(T.ιFermion j y * T.ιFermion i x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBoson_commute
declarations.doc: Bosonic generators commute, across species as well as within one.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBoson_commute (i j : T.BosonSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.boson i))
    (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) :
    Commute (T.ιBoson i x) (T.ιBoson j y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBoson_commute_ιFermion
declarations.doc: A bosonic generator commutes with a fermionic one, bosons being even.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBoson_commute_ιFermion (j : T.BosonSpecies) (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    Commute (T.ιBoson j y) (T.ιFermion i x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιBoson_commute_ιConnection
declarations.doc: A bosonic generator commutes with a connection generator.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιBoson_commute_ιConnection (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    Commute (T.ιBoson j y) (T.ιConnection v)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ιConnection_commute_ιFermion
declarations.doc: A connection generator commutes with a fermionic one, the connection being even.
declarations.statement:
lemma ιConnection_commute_ιFermion (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    Commute (T.ιConnection v) (T.ιFermion i x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.generators
declarations.doc: The generators of the local field algebra, the images of the three generator spaces.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def generators : Set T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.adjoin_matter_generators_eq_top
declarations.doc:
The matter factor `Λ_ℂ E_f(T) ⊗[ℂ] Sym_ℂ E_b(T)` is generated by the images of the
fermionic and bosonic generators.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjoin_matter_generators_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
        (Set.range (fun v : T.FermionGenerators =>
            ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ v ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1 : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators))
          ∪ Set.range (fun v : T.BosonGenerators =>
            (1 : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
              SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ T.BosonGenerators v)) = ⊤

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.adjoin_generators_eq_top
declarations.doc:
The local field algebra is generated by its three families of generators. Every
element is a polynomial in the fermionic, bosonic and connection symbols; this is the
algebraic form of "every local expression is a polynomial in the fields and their
derivatives", and it is what forces uniqueness in the universal property.
declarations.statement: lemma adjoin_generators_eq_top : Algebra.adjoin ℂ T.generators = ⊤

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.algHom_ext_generators
declarations.doc:
Two algebra maps out of the local field algebra agreeing on the whole of the three
generator spaces are equal. The target is not assumed commutative, so this cannot be
deduced from `SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext`; it comes from generation.
declarations.statement:
lemma algHom_ext_generators {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {Φ Ψ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B}
    (hf : ∀ v, Φ (T.ιFermionTotal v) = Ψ (T.ιFermionTotal v))
    (hb : ∀ v, Φ (T.ιBosonTotal v) = Ψ (T.ιBosonTotal v))
    (ha : ∀ v, Φ (T.ιConnection v) = Ψ (T.ιConnection v)) : Φ = Ψ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.algHom_ext
declarations.doc:
Two algebra maps out of `J(T)` are equal as soon as they agree on the generators of
every species and on the connection generators. A linear map out of the fermionic
generator space is determined by its restrictions to the species, so the species-wise
hypotheses already give the hypotheses of `algHom_ext_generators`.
declarations.statement:
lemma algHom_ext {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B] {Φ Ψ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B}
    (hf : ∀ i x, Φ (T.ιFermion i x) = Ψ (T.ιFermion i x))
    (hb : ∀ j y, Φ (T.ιBoson j y) = Ψ (T.ιBoson j y))
    (ha : ∀ v, Φ (T.ιConnection v) = Ψ (T.ιConnection v)) : Φ = Ψ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment
declarations.doc:
A compatible assignment of the generators of the local field algebra of a datum in a
complex algebra `B`, given by one linear map per fermionic species, one per bosonic
species and one real-linear map on the connection generators, subject to exactly the
relations of section A.2. The algebra `B` is not assumed commutative, and the commutation
conditions are imposed only between the assigned images, not between an image and an
arbitrary element of `B`.

`fermion_mul_swap` is not redundant. The square-zero condition the algebra imposes is on
the whole fermionic generator space, and by `DirectSum.mul_self_iff_lof` that condition is
equivalent to `fermion_mul_self` together with `fermion_mul_swap`; species-wise
square-zero alone leaves the cross terms of `(x + y) * (x + y)` for `x` and `y` in
different species.
declarations.statement:
structure Assignment (B : Type*) [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] where
  /-- The images of the generators of each fermionic species. -/
  fermion : ∀ i, JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i) →ₗ[ℂ] B
  /-- The images of the generators of each bosonic species. -/
  boson : ∀ j, JetComponentSpace (T.boson j) →ₗ[ℂ] B
  /-- The images of the connection generators; only real-linear, as the connection
    generator space is real. -/
  connection : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] B
  /-- Fermi statistics within a species. -/
  fermion_mul_self : ∀ i x, fermion i x * fermion i x = 0
  /-- Fermi statistics across species, which does not follow from `fermion_mul_self`. -/
  fermion_mul_swap : ∀ i j x y, fermion i x * fermion j y = -(fermion j y * fermion i x)
  /-- Bosonic images commute, across species as well as within one. -/
  boson_commute : ∀ i j x y, Commute (boson i x) (boson j y)
  /-- Connection images commute pairwise. -/
  connection_commute : ∀ v w, Commute (connection v) (connection w)
  /-- Bosonic and connection images commute with each other. -/
  boson_commute_connection : ∀ j y w, Commute (boson j y) (connection w)
  /-- Bosonic images commute with fermionic images. -/
  boson_commute_fermion : ∀ j i y x, Commute (boson j y) (fermion i x)
  /-- Connection images commute with fermionic images. -/
  connection_commute_fermion : ∀ v i x, Commute (connection v) (fermion i x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.assemble_mul_self_iff
declarations.doc:
Species-wise square-zero is not square-zero. The condition the local field algebra
imposes on the assembled fermionic map is equivalent to the two fields
`Assignment.fermion_mul_self` and `Assignment.fermion_mul_swap` together; the second is
vacuous only for a family with at most one species.
declarations.statement:
lemma assemble_mul_self_iff {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (f : ∀ i, JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i) →ₗ[ℂ] B) :
    (∀ v, T.assembleFermion f v * T.assembleFermion f v = 0)
      ↔ ((∀ i x, f i x * f i x = 0) ∧
        ∀ i j x y, f i x * f j y = -(f j y * f i x))

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionTotal
declarations.doc: The images of all the fermionic generators at once, assembled from the species.
declarations.statement: def fermionTotal : T.FermionGenerators →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonTotal
declarations.doc: The images of all the bosonic generators at once.
declarations.statement: def bosonTotal : T.BosonGenerators →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionTotal_inclFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma fermionTotal_inclFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    d.fermionTotal (T.inclFermion i x) = d.fermion i x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonTotal_inclBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma bosonTotal_inclBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) :
    d.bosonTotal (T.inclBoson j y) = d.boson j y

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionTotal_mul_self
declarations.doc:
The assembled fermionic images square to zero, which is more than the species-wise
condition and needs the cross-species anticommutation as well.
declarations.statement:
lemma fermionTotal_mul_self (v : T.FermionGenerators) :
    d.fermionTotal v * d.fermionTotal v = 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionTotal_mul_swap
declarations.doc:
The images of two fermionic generators anticommute. Only `fermion_mul_self` and
`fermion_mul_swap` are assumed, and only species by species; because their conjunction is
square-zero on the whole generator space, polarization yields the relation for arbitrary
vectors, sums across species included.
declarations.statement:
lemma fermionTotal_mul_swap (v w : T.FermionGenerators) :
    d.fermionTotal v * d.fermionTotal w = -(d.fermionTotal w * d.fermionTotal v)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonTotal_commute
declarations.doc: The assembled bosonic images commute pairwise.
declarations.statement:
lemma bosonTotal_commute (v w : T.BosonGenerators) :
    Commute (d.bosonTotal v) (d.bosonTotal w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonTotal_commute_connection
declarations.doc: The assembled bosonic images commute with the connection images.
declarations.statement:
lemma bosonTotal_commute_connection (v : T.BosonGenerators)
    (w : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) : Commute (d.bosonTotal v) (d.connection w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonTotal_commute_fermionTotal
declarations.doc: The assembled bosonic images commute with the assembled fermionic images.
declarations.statement:
lemma bosonTotal_commute_fermionTotal (v : T.BosonGenerators) (w : T.FermionGenerators) :
    Commute (d.bosonTotal v) (d.fermionTotal w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.connection_commute_fermionTotal
declarations.doc: The connection images commute with the assembled fermionic images.
declarations.statement:
lemma connection_commute_fermionTotal (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)
    (w : T.FermionGenerators) : Commute (d.connection v) (d.fermionTotal w)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.evenGenerators
declarations.doc: The even generator images, the bosonic and connection images together.
declarations.statement: def evenGenerators : Set B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.evenSubalgebra
declarations.doc:
The commutative subalgebra of `B` generated by the even images. The bosonic and
connection assignments are lifted into it, because `SymmetricAlgebra.lift` requires a
commutative target while `B` itself need not be commutative.
declarations.statement: def evenSubalgebra : Subalgebra ℂ B
instance : IsMulCommutative d.evenSubalgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonGenerator
declarations.doc: The bosonic assignment, corestricted to the commutative subalgebra of even images.
declarations.statement: def bosonGenerator : T.BosonGenerators →ₗ[ℂ] d.evenSubalgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.connectionGenerator
declarations.doc:
The connection assignment, corestricted to the commutative subalgebra of even
images.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def connectionGenerator :
    GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] d.evenSubalgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionHom
declarations.doc:
The algebra map out of the fermionic factor, the exterior lift of the assembled
fermionic images, which already accepts an associative, possibly noncommutative,
target.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def fermionHom : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators →ₐ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonHom
declarations.doc:
The algebra map out of the bosonic factor, the symmetric lift into the commutative
subalgebra of even images, followed by its inclusion.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def bosonHom : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators →ₐ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.connectionHomReal
declarations.doc: The real algebra map out of the real connection factor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def connectionHomReal :
    SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) →ₐ[ℝ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.connectionHom
declarations.doc:
The algebra map out of the complexified connection factor, obtained from
`connectionHomReal` by the universal property of extension of scalars, which, unlike the
symmetric lift, accepts a noncommutative target.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def connectionHom :
    (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) →ₐ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionHom_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma fermionHom_ι (v : T.FermionGenerators) :
    d.fermionHom (ExteriorAlgebra.ι ℂ v) = d.fermionTotal v

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonHom_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma bosonHom_ι (v : T.BosonGenerators) :
    d.bosonHom (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ T.BosonGenerators v) = d.bosonTotal v

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.connectionHomReal_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma connectionHomReal_ι (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    d.connectionHomReal (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) v)
      = d.connection v

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.connectionHom_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma connectionHom_tmul (z : ℂ)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    d.connectionHom (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] p) = z • d.connectionHomReal p

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionHom_commute_bosonHom
declarations.statement:
lemma fermionHom_commute_bosonHom (x : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators)
    (y : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators) :
    Commute (d.fermionHom x) (d.bosonHom y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.fermionHom_commute_connectionHom
declarations.statement:
lemma fermionHom_commute_connectionHom (x : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    Commute (d.fermionHom x) (d.connectionHom y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.bosonHom_commute_connectionHom
declarations.statement:
lemma bosonHom_commute_connectionHom (x : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    Commute (d.bosonHom x) (d.connectionHom y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.matterHom
declarations.doc: The algebra map out of the matter factor `Λ_ℂ E_f(T) ⊗[ℂ] Sym_ℂ E_b(T)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def matterHom :
    (ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators ⊗[ℂ] SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators) →ₐ[ℂ]
      B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.matterHom_commute_connectionHom
declarations.statement:
lemma matterHom_commute_connectionHom
    (x : ExteriorAlgebra ℂ T.FermionGenerators ⊗[ℂ] SymmetricAlgebra ℂ T.BosonGenerators)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤)) :
    Commute (d.matterHom x) (d.connectionHom y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.lift
declarations.doc:
The realization arrow of the datum: the algebra homomorphism `J(T) →ₐ[ℂ] B` induced by
a compatible assignment.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def lift : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.lift_ιFermionTotal
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_ιFermionTotal (v : T.FermionGenerators) :
    d.lift (T.ιFermionTotal v) = d.fermionTotal v

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.lift_ιBosonTotal
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_ιBosonTotal (v : T.BosonGenerators) :
    d.lift (T.ιBosonTotal v) = d.bosonTotal v

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.lift_ιConnection
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_ιConnection (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    d.lift (T.ιConnection v) = d.connection v

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.lift_ιFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_ιFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    d.lift (T.ιFermion i x) = d.fermion i x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.lift_ιBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_ιBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) :
    d.lift (T.ιBoson j y) = d.boson j y

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.existsUnique_algHom
declarations.doc:
The mapping-out universal property of the local field algebra of a datum. A compatible
assignment of the generators of every species, and of the connection, in an arbitrary, in
particular noncommutative, complex algebra `B` extends to one and only one complex algebra
homomorphism `J(T) →ₐ[ℂ] B`. Injectivity is neither claimed nor wanted, since a
realization may identify local expressions.
declarations.statement:
lemma existsUnique_algHom :
    ∃! Φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B,
      (∀ i x, Φ (T.ιFermion i x) = d.fermion i x) ∧
        (∀ j y, Φ (T.ιBoson j y) = d.boson j y) ∧
          (∀ v, Φ (T.ιConnection v) = d.connection v)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.comp
declarations.doc:
The compatible assignment obtained by pushing one forward along an algebra map, every
relation being preserved by an algebra homomorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def comp {C : Type*} [Ring C] [Algebra ℂ C] (φ : B →ₐ[ℂ] C) :
    T.Assignment C

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.canonicalAssignment
declarations.doc:
The tautological assignment, with the generators of the local field algebra assigned to
themselves. Its relations are those of section A.2.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def canonicalAssignment : T.Assignment T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.liftEquiv
declarations.doc:
Compatible assignments in `B` are the same thing as algebra maps into `B`. This is the
universal property as an equivalence of types rather than a linear equivalence, neither
side being a module in a way the other respects.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def liftEquiv (B : Type*) [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B] :
    T.Assignment B ≃ (T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.Assignment.range_lift
declarations.doc:
The range of the induced map is the complex subalgebra generated by the images of the
species and of the connection. No injectivity is claimed or required, since a realization
of a field theory may identify local expressions.
declarations.statement:
lemma range_lift :
    d.lift.range
      = Algebra.adjoin ℂ
        ((⋃ i, Set.range (d.fermion i)) ∪ (⋃ j, Set.range (d.boson j))
          ∪ Set.range d.connection)

modules.title: The covariant derivatives in the local field algebra
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The covariant expressions of a gauge theory are the iterated covariant derivatives of its
matter fields and of the field strength, built here inside the local field algebra `J(T)`
of a field datum. For a matter species the tower is `GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter`
on the symbol family of the species: `∇_{l 0} ⋯ ∇_{l (n-1)} ψ` along an ordered tuple `l`
of directions, with `∇_ρ F = [∂_ρ F] + A_ρ · F` through the infinitesimal action
`repAlgebra` of the species on the value index, the conjugate components through the
conjugate action. Zero derivatives is the undifferentiated symbol, and the ordered labels
are kept: nothing is identified with the multiset-indexed ordinary derivatives. For the
gauge bosons the tower is the gauge-only `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength`,
included through the connection factor.

A jet acts on every tower through the base-point Taylor coefficient of its inverse on the
value index alone, unconditionally; under `MatterField.PureJetsActTrivially` the action on
a matter tower factors through evaluation to the ordinary gauge group. A Lorentz
transformation mixes the covariant slots by the columns of the Lorentz matrix and the value
index contragrediently, under `MatterField.GaugeLorentzCompatible` for the matter towers
and unconditionally for the field strength.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeFieldData.covDerivFermion`, `GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjFermion`,
  `GaugeFieldData.covDerivBoson`, `GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjBoson`,
  `GaugeFieldData.covDerivFieldStrength` : the covariant towers.
- `GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivFermion` and companions : the gauge laws;
  `GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivFermion_ofConstant_eval` and companions : the
  factorization through evaluation.
- `GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFermion` and companions : the Lorentz laws;
  `GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFermion_mem` and companions : a Lorentz
  transformation of a tower element lies in any subalgebra containing the tower.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The covariant matter towers
- B. The included field-strength tower
- C. The gauge laws
- D. The Lorentz laws
  - D.1. Transformed tower elements in a subalgebra containing the tower

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The covariant matter towers
## B. The included field-strength tower
## C. The gauge laws
## D. The Lorentz laws

### D.1. Transformed tower elements in a subalgebra containing the tower

The Lorentz laws mix a tower element only with elements of the same tower, so its Lorentz
transformation lies in any subalgebra containing the required tower elements. This says
nothing about the other elements of such a subalgebra; the covariant field algebra and its
sector subalgebras obtain their stability from it by generation.

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFermion
declarations.doc:
The iterated covariant derivative `∇_{l 0} ⋯ ∇_{l (n-1)} ψ` of a fermionic species along
an ordered tuple of directions, as a family over the covectors of its value space.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covDerivFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjFermion
declarations.doc:
The iterated covariant derivative of the conjugate components of a fermionic species,
through the conjugate infinitesimal action.

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivBoson
declarations.doc: The iterated covariant derivative of a bosonic species.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covDerivBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjBoson
declarations.doc: The iterated covariant derivative of the conjugate components of a bosonic species.

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFermion_zero
declarations.doc: Zero covariant derivatives: the undifferentiated symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFermion_zero (i : T.FermionSpecies) (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivFermion i l = T.fermionSymbol i 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjFermion_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivConjFermion_zero (i : T.FermionSpecies) (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivConjFermion i l = T.conjFermionSymbol i 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivBoson_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivBoson_zero (j : T.BosonSpecies) (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivBoson j l = T.bosonSymbol j 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjBoson_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivConjBoson_zero (j : T.BosonSpecies) (l : Fin 0 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivConjBoson j l = T.conjBosonSymbol j 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFermion_succ
declarations.doc:
One more covariant derivative, peeled off the front of the tuple: the derivative symbol
`[∂_{l 0} ∇_{l'} ψ]` of the lower tower plus the derived action `A_{l 0} · ∇_{l'} ψ` of the
gauge field on its value index, both read off the lower tower as a family.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFermion_succ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivFermion i l
      = covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A (T.fermion i).repAlgebra (T.fermionSymbol i) n
          (fun k => l k.succ) {l 0}
        + actionFamConv T.gaugeRealization.A (T.fermion i).repAlgebra (l 0)
          (covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A (T.fermion i).repAlgebra (T.fermionSymbol i) n
            fun k => l k.succ) 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjFermion_succ
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivConjFermion_succ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivConjFermion i l
      = covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.fermion i).repAlgebra)
          (T.conjFermionSymbol i) n (fun k => l k.succ) {l 0}
        + actionFamConv T.gaugeRealization.A (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.fermion i).repAlgebra)
          (l 0) (covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A
            (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.fermion i).repAlgebra) (T.conjFermionSymbol i) n
            fun k => l k.succ) 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivBoson_succ
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivBoson_succ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivBoson j l
      = covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A (T.boson j).repAlgebra (T.bosonSymbol j) n
          (fun k => l k.succ) {l 0}
        + actionFamConv T.gaugeRealization.A (T.boson j).repAlgebra (l 0)
          (covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A (T.boson j).repAlgebra (T.bosonSymbol j) n
            fun k => l k.succ) 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivConjBoson_succ
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivConjBoson_succ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    T.covDerivConjBoson j l
      = covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.boson j).repAlgebra)
          (T.conjBosonSymbol j) n (fun k => l k.succ) {l 0}
        + actionFamConv T.gaugeRealization.A (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.boson j).repAlgebra)
          (l 0) (covDerivIter T.gaugeRealization.A
            (LocalGaugeData.actionConj (T.boson j).repAlgebra) (T.conjBosonSymbol j) n
            fun k => l k.succ) 0

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The field strength and its ordered covariant derivatives `∇_l F_μν^φ`, included from
the real gauge-only algebra through the connection factor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covDerivFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFieldStrength_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_apply (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
          LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength 𝔤 l μ ν φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFieldStrength_nil
declarations.doc: Zero covariant derivatives: the included field strength.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    T.covDerivFieldStrength [] μ ν φ
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength 𝔤 μ ν φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covDerivFieldStrength_eq_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
declarations.doc:
The included tower is the covariant tower of the gauge-field symbols of `J(T)` computed
by the realization theory, the tower being natural along the inclusion of the connection
factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_eq_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ
      = iteratedCovDerivAdjoint T.gaugeRealization.A l
          (fieldStrength T.gaugeRealization.A μ ν) 0 φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivFermion
declarations.doc:
The gauge law of the covariant tower of a fermionic species: a jet acts through the
zeroth dual Taylor coefficient of its inverse on the value index alone.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivFermion i l φ)
      = T.covDerivFermion i l (repDualCoeff (T.fermion i).repJet U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivConjFermion
declarations.doc:
The gauge law of the conjugate covariant tower of a fermionic species, through the
conjugate representation.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivConjFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ)
      = T.covDerivConjFermion i l
          (repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj (T.fermion i).repJet) U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivBoson
declarations.doc: The gauge law of the covariant tower of a bosonic species.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivBoson j l φ)
      = T.covDerivBoson j l (repDualCoeff (T.boson j).repJet U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivConjBoson
declarations.doc: The gauge law of the conjugate covariant tower of a bosonic species.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivConjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ)
      = T.covDerivConjBoson j l
          (repDualCoeff (JetComponentSpace.repConj (T.boson j).repJet) U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The gauge law of the included field-strength tower: a jet acts through the dual
adjoint action of the value of its inverse, from the gauge-only law.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ)
      = T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν ((jets.adjoint (jets.eval U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivFermion_ofConstant_eval
declarations.doc:
Under `MatterField.PureJetsActTrivially` for the species, the jet action on its
covariant tower factors through evaluation: a jet acts as the constant jet of its
value.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivFermion_ofConstant_eval (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (hi : (T.fermion i).PureJetsActTrivially) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivFermion i l φ)
      = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (T.covDerivFermion i l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivConjFermion_ofConstant_eval
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivConjFermion_ofConstant_eval (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (hi : (T.fermion i).PureJetsActTrivially) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ)
      = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivBoson_ofConstant_eval
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivBoson_ofConstant_eval (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (hj : (T.boson j).PureJetsActTrivially) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivBoson j l φ)
      = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (T.covDerivBoson j l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivConjBoson_ofConstant_eval
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivConjBoson_ofConstant_eval (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (hj : (T.boson j).PureJetsActTrivially) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ)
      = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_ofConstant_eval
declarations.doc:
The jet action on the field-strength tower factors through evaluation, with no
condition.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_ofConstant_eval (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    T.repJet U (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ)
      = T.repJet (jets.ofConstant (jets.eval U)) (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFermion
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of a fermionic species, under
`MatterField.GaugeLorentzCompatible` for the species: every covariant slot mixes by the
columns of the Lorentz matrix and the value index transforms contragrediently.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (hi : (T.fermion i).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivFermion i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          T.covDerivFermion i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjFermion
declarations.doc: The Lorentz law of the conjugate covariant tower of a fermionic species.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (hi : (T.fermion i).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          T.covDerivConjFermion i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivBoson
declarations.doc: The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of a bosonic species.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (hj : (T.boson j).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivBoson j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          T.covDerivBoson j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjBoson
declarations.doc: The Lorentz law of the conjugate covariant tower of a bosonic species.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (hj : (T.boson j).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          T.covDerivConjBoson j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the field-strength tower, with no condition: every covariant slot
and both covector indices mix by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivFieldStrength (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • T.covDerivFieldStrength (List.ofFn p) a b φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFermion_mem
declarations.doc:
Under `MatterField.GaugeLorentzCompatible` for the species, a Lorentz transformation
carries an element of the covariant tower of a fermionic species into any subalgebra
containing the tower of that length.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivFermion_mem (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (hi : (T.fermion i).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i))
    (hS : ∀ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)),
      T.covDerivFermion i p ψ ∈ S) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivFermion i l φ) ∈ S

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjFermion_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjFermion_mem (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (hi : (T.fermion i).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i)))
    (hS : ∀ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))),
      T.covDerivConjFermion i p ψ ∈ S) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ) ∈ S

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivBoson_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivBoson_mem (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (hj : (T.boson j).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j))
    (hS : ∀ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)),
      T.covDerivBoson j p ψ ∈ S) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivBoson j l φ) ∈ S

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjBoson_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivConjBoson_mem (j : T.BosonSpecies)
    (hj : (T.boson j).GaugeLorentzCompatible) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j)))
    (hS : ∀ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ψ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))),
      T.covDerivConjBoson j p ψ ∈ S) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ) ∈ S

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength_mem
declarations.doc:
A Lorentz transformation carries an element of the field-strength tower into any
subalgebra containing the whole tower of its adjoint covector, with no condition.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength_mem (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ 𝔤)
    (hS : ∀ (l' : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      T.covDerivFieldStrength l' a b φ ∈ S) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ) ∈ S

modules.title: The jet gauge action on the local field algebra
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The jet gauge group `GJ` acts on the local field algebra `J(T)` of a field datum by algebra
endomorphisms: on the generators of a matter species by the action
`JetComponentSpace.repJet` of that species, and on the connection generators by the affine
action `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet` of the gauge-only algebra, with its Maurer–Cartan
shift. The three generator actions form a compatible assignment, whose lift through the
universal property of `J(T)` is the action of one jet; the representation laws follow from
uniqueness, without unfolding the tensor-product carrier.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom`, `GaugeFieldData.repJet` : the action of a jet, as an
  algebra endomorphism and as a representation, with `repJet_ιFermion`, `repJet_ιBoson`,
  `repJet_ιConnection` on the generators.
- `GaugeFieldData.repJet_includeConnection` : on the connection factor the action is the
  complexified gauge-only action.
- `GaugeFieldData.repJet_ιConnection_affine` : the affine law of the connection generators.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The gauge assignment of a jet
- B. The action of a jet
- C. The action on the connection factor
- D. The representation

## iv. References

* None.

## B. The action of a jet
## C. The action on the connection factor
## D. The representation

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.gaugeConnection
declarations.doc:
The connection generators after the action of a jet: the gauge-only action on the
degree-one element, included into the local field algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeConnection (U : GJ) :
    GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤 →ₗ[ℝ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.gaugeAssignment
declarations.doc:
The assignment of the generators defining the action of a jet: each matter species
acts on its own component functions, the connection generators through the gauge-only
action. The relations hold because the images are generators of the same kind, or lie in
the central connection factor.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gaugeAssignment (U : GJ) : T.Assignment T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom
declarations.doc:
The action of a jet on the local field algebra, as an algebra endomorphism: the lift
of its gauge assignment.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repJetAlgHom (U : GJ) : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_ιFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_ιFermion (U : GJ) (i : T.FermionSpecies)
    (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    T.repJetAlgHom U (T.ιFermion i x)
      = T.ιFermion i (JetComponentSpace.repJet (T.fermion i) U x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_ιBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_ιBoson (U : GJ) (j : T.BosonSpecies) (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) :
    T.repJetAlgHom U (T.ιBoson j y) = T.ιBoson j (JetComponentSpace.repJet (T.boson j) U y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_ιConnection
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_ιConnection (U : GJ) (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    T.repJetAlgHom U (T.ιConnection v)
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
          LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets U (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ v))

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_comp_includeConnection
declarations.doc:
The action of a jet restricts to the complexified gauge-only action on the connection
factor, as an equation of algebra maps out of the complexified gauge-only algebra: it is
enough to compare them on the real generators, where it is the computation rule of the
lift.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_comp_includeConnection (U : GJ) :
    (T.repJetAlgHom U).comp T.includeConnection
      = T.includeConnection.comp (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJetAlgHom jets U)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_includeConnection
declarations.doc:
The action of a jet restricts to the complexified gauge-only action on the connection
factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_includeConnection (U : GJ) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.repJetAlgHom U (T.includeConnection y)
      = T.includeConnection (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet jets U y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_includeConnection_one_tmul
declarations.doc: On the real gauge-only algebra, included, a jet acts through the gauge-only action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_includeConnection_one_tmul (U : GJ) (x : LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.repJetAlgHom U (T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x))
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets U x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_one
declarations.doc: The identity jet acts as the identity.
declarations.statement: lemma repJetAlgHom_one : T.repJetAlgHom 1 = AlgHom.id ℂ T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJetAlgHom_mul
declarations.doc: The action of a product of jets is the composite of the actions.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetAlgHom_mul (U V : GJ) :
    T.repJetAlgHom (U * V) = (T.repJetAlgHom U).comp (T.repJetAlgHom V)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet
declarations.doc: The action of the jet gauge group on the local field algebra.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℂ GJ T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_apply (U : GJ) (x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repJet U x = T.repJetAlgHom U x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_apply_mul (U : GJ) (x y : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repJet U (x * y) = T.repJet U x * T.repJet U y

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_apply_one
declarations.statement: lemma repJet_apply_one (U : GJ) : T.repJet U (1 : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = 1

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_ιFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_ιFermion (U : GJ) (i : T.FermionSpecies) (x : JetComponentSpace (T.fermion i)) :
    T.repJet U (T.ιFermion i x) = T.ιFermion i (JetComponentSpace.repJet (T.fermion i) U x)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_ιBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_ιBoson (U : GJ) (j : T.BosonSpecies) (y : JetComponentSpace (T.boson j)) :
    T.repJet U (T.ιBoson j y) = T.ιBoson j (JetComponentSpace.repJet (T.boson j) U y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_ιConnection
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_ιConnection (U : GJ) (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    T.repJet U (T.ιConnection v)
      = T.includeConnection ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
          LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet jets U (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ v))

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_includeConnection
declarations.doc:
The jet gauge action restricts to the complexified gauge-only action on the connection
factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_includeConnection (U : GJ) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤) :
    T.repJet U (T.includeConnection y)
      = T.includeConnection (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet jets U y)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.repJet_ιConnection_affine
declarations.doc:
The affine gauge law of the connection generators: a jet carries a connection
generator to the transported generator of its inverse plus the Maurer–Cartan shift, the
gauge field being a connection and not a tensor. This is the generator-level form of
`GaugeFieldData.repJet_ιConnection`, with no reference to the connection factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_ιConnection_affine (U : GJ) (v : GaugeBoson.JetComponentSpace 𝔤) :
    T.repJet U (T.ιConnection v)
      = T.ιConnection (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport jets U⁻¹ v)
        + (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mcShift jets U⁻¹ v : ℂ) • (1 : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)

modules.title: The gauge sector as the complexified gauge-only algebra
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The gauge sector `T.SectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge}` of the local field algebra is the
complex subalgebra generated by the connection symbols. The gauge-only algebra
`LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤` is real, a connection being a real object, so the comparison is
with its complexification: the canonical inclusion `T.includeConnection` is injective with
range that sector, and the resulting equivalence intertwines the complexified gauge-only
actions with the restricted sector actions.

Injectivity comes from a retraction, the lift of the assignment sending every matter
generator to zero and keeping the connection generators. No nontriviality, no basis and no
additional finite-dimensionality assumption is used; the ambient `[Module.Finite ℝ 𝔤]` of
the surrounding modules is unchanged. Neither condition on the matter species is needed.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeFieldData.connectionRetraction` : the retraction onto the complexified gauge-only
  algebra, and `GaugeFieldData.includeConnection_injective`.
- `GaugeFieldData.range_includeConnection` : the range of the inclusion is the gauge
  sector.
- `GaugeFieldData.gaugeSectorEquiv` : the equivalence
  `ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra 𝔤 ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(T.SectorAlgebra {FieldCategory.gauge})`.
- `GaugeFieldData.gaugeSectorEquiv_complexRepJet`,
  `GaugeFieldData.gaugeSectorEquiv_complexRepLorentzGroup` : the two intertwining laws.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The retraction onto the connection factor
  - A.1. Injectivity of the inclusion
- B. The range of the inclusion
- C. The equivalence with the gauge sector
  - C.1. Computation on generators and symbols
- D. Compatibility with the symmetries

## iv. References

* None.
