declarations.name: GellMann.Index
declarations.doc:
The labels of the generalized Gell-Mann matrices: a pair `j < k` for each symmetric and each
antisymmetric matrix, and `l : Fin (N - 1)` for the diagonal matrix of size `n = l + 1`.
declarations.statement: abbrev Index (N : ℕ) : Type

declarations.name: GellMann.diagProfile
declarations.doc:
The diagonal profile of size `n = l + 1`: `1` on the first `n` entries, `-n` on the next, and
`0` beyond.
declarations.statement: def diagProfile (l : Fin (N - 1)) (m : Fin N) : ℂ

declarations.name: GellMann.diagNorm
declarations.doc: The normalization `√(2 / (n (n + 1)))` of the diagonal matrix of size `n = l + 1`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def diagNorm (l : Fin (N - 1)) : ℂ

declarations.name: GellMann.matrix
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def matrix : Index N → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ

declarations.name: GellMann.sum_diagProfile
declarations.statement: lemma sum_diagProfile (l : Fin (N - 1)) : ∑ m, diagProfile l m = 0

declarations.name: GellMann.sum_diagProfile_mul
declarations.doc: The diagonal profiles are orthogonal, with `∑ d_l (m)² = n (n + 1)` for `n = l + 1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_diagProfile_mul (l l' : Fin (N - 1)) :
    ∑ m, diagProfile l m * diagProfile l' m
      = if l = l' then ((l.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((l.val + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0

declarations.name: GellMann.diagNorm_mul_self
declarations.doc:
The square of the normalization of the diagonal matrix of size `n = l + 1` is
`2 / (n (n + 1))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma diagNorm_mul_self (l : Fin (N - 1)) :
    diagNorm l * diagNorm l * (((l.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((l.val + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ)) = 2

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inl_mul
declarations.doc: The trace of a symmetric Gell-Mann matrix against `X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_inl_mul (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (matrix (.inl p) * X).trace = X p.1.2 p.1.1 + X p.1.1 p.1.2

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul
declarations.doc: The trace of an antisymmetric Gell-Mann matrix against `X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2})
    (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inl p)) * X).trace
      = -Complex.I * X p.1.2 p.1.1 + Complex.I * X p.1.1 p.1.2

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul
declarations.doc: The trace of a diagonal Gell-Mann matrix against `X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul (l : Fin (N - 1)) (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inr l)) * X).trace = diagNorm l * ∑ m, diagProfile l m * X m m

declarations.name: GellMann.matrix_inl_apply
declarations.doc: The entries of a symmetric Gell-Mann matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_inl_apply (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (m n : Fin N) :
    matrix (.inl p) m n
      = (if p.1.1 = m ∧ p.1.2 = n then 1 else 0) + (if p.1.2 = m ∧ p.1.1 = n then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: GellMann.matrix_inr_inl_apply
declarations.doc: The entries of an antisymmetric Gell-Mann matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_inr_inl_apply (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (m n : Fin N) :
    matrix (.inr (.inl p)) m n = (if p.1.1 = m ∧ p.1.2 = n then -Complex.I else 0)
      + (if p.1.2 = m ∧ p.1.1 = n then Complex.I else 0)

declarations.name: GellMann.matrix_inr_inr_apply
declarations.doc: The entries of a diagonal Gell-Mann matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_inr_inr_apply (l : Fin (N - 1)) (m n : Fin N) :
    matrix (.inr (.inr l)) m n = if m = n then diagNorm l * diagProfile l m else 0

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inl_mul_matrix
declarations.doc: The symmetric Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal to all others and have norm `2`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_inl_mul_matrix (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (b : Index N) :
    (matrix (.inl p) * matrix b).trace = if .inl p = b then 2 else 0

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul_matrix
declarations.doc: The antisymmetric Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal to all others and have norm `2`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inl_mul_matrix (p : {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2}) (b : Index N) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inl p)) * matrix b).trace = if .inr (.inl p) = b then 2 else 0

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul_matrix
declarations.doc: The diagonal Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal to all others and have norm `2`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_inr_inr_mul_matrix (l : Fin (N - 1)) (b : Index N) :
    (matrix (.inr (.inr l)) * matrix b).trace = if .inr (.inr l) = b then 2 else 0

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix_mul_matrix
declarations.doc:
The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are orthogonal under the trace form:
`tr (λ_a λ_b) = 2 δ_ab`.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_matrix_mul_matrix (a b : Index N) :
    (matrix a * matrix b).trace = if a = b then 2 else 0

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_matrix
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are traceless.
declarations.statement: lemma trace_matrix (a : Index N) : (matrix a).trace = 0

declarations.name: GellMann.conjTranspose_matrix
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are hermitian.
declarations.statement: lemma conjTranspose_matrix (a : Index N) : (matrix a)ᴴ = matrix a

declarations.name: GellMann.traceless
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices as traceless matrices.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def traceless (a : Index N) :
    ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))

declarations.name: GellMann.linearIndependent_traceless
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are linearly independent, by orthogonality.
declarations.statement: lemma linearIndependent_traceless : LinearIndependent ℂ (traceless (N := N))

declarations.name: GellMann.two_mul_card_lt_add
declarations.doc:
There are `N² - 1` ordered pairs with `j < k`, counted twice, and `N - 1` diagonal labels:
`2 #{j < k} + N = N²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma two_mul_card_lt_add :
    2 * Fintype.card {p : Fin N × Fin N // p.1 < p.2} + N = N * N

declarations.name: GellMann.finrank_traceless
declarations.doc: The traceless `N × N` matrices have dimension `N² - 1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma finrank_traceless :
    finrank ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ)) = N * N - 1

declarations.name: GellMann.card_index
declarations.statement:
lemma card_index : Fintype.card (Index N)
    = finrank ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))

declarations.name: GellMann.basis
declarations.doc: **The generalized Gell-Mann basis** of the traceless complex `N × N` matrices.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def basis : Basis (Index N) ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))

declarations.name: GellMann.basis_apply_val
declarations.statement: lemma basis_apply_val (a : Index N) : (basis a).1 = matrix a

declarations.name: GellMann.basis_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
The coordinates of a traceless matrix in the Gell-Mann basis are read off by the trace form,
`x = ∑ (tr (λ_a x) / 2) λ_a`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_apply (x : ↥(LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ))) (a : Index N) :
    basis.repr x a = (matrix a * x.1).trace / 2

declarations.name: GellMann.hermitian
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices as elements of the real Lie algebra `su(N)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def hermitian (a : Index N) : SUAlgebraOver ℂ N

declarations.name: GellMann.linearIndependent_hermitian
declarations.doc: The generalized Gell-Mann matrices are linearly independent over the reals.
declarations.statement: lemma linearIndependent_hermitian : LinearIndependent ℝ (hermitian (N := N))

declarations.name: GellMann.trace_mul_ofReal_re
declarations.doc: The trace pairing of two hermitian matrices is real.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_mul_ofReal_re {A H : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (hH : Hᴴ = H) :
    (((A * H).trace.re : ℝ) : ℂ) = (A * H).trace

declarations.name: GellMann.eq_sum_re_trace_smul_hermitian
declarations.doc:
A traceless hermitian matrix is the real combination `∑ (tr (λ_a H) / 2) λ_a` of the
generalized Gell-Mann matrices.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_sum_re_trace_smul_hermitian (H : SUAlgebraOver ℂ N) :
    ∑ a, ((matrix a * H.1).trace.re / 2) • hermitian a = H

declarations.name: GellMann.realBasis
declarations.doc: **The generalized Gell-Mann basis** of the real Lie algebra `su(N)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def realBasis : Basis (Index N) ℝ (SUAlgebraOver ℂ N)

declarations.name: GellMann.realBasis_apply_val
declarations.statement: lemma realBasis_apply_val (a : Index N) : (realBasis a).1 = matrix a

modules.title: Invariants of one and of two adjoint indices of `SU(N)`
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

A tensor with one adjoint index is an element `A` of the complexified Lie algebra `ℂ ⊗[ℝ] su(N)`,
moved by `g` to `g A g⁻¹`. The matrix of an invariant one commutes with every element of `SU(N)`, so
it is scalar (`SU.eq_smul_one_of_commute`), and being traceless it is zero (A).

A tensor with two adjoint indices has a matrix of components `C` in the Gell-Mann basis, moved by
`g` to `M C Mᵀ`, where `M` is the matrix of the adjoint action of `g`. That matrix is real and
`Mᵀ` is the matrix of `g⁻¹`, so the components of an invariant tensor are the matrix of an
endomorphism of the complexified Lie algebra commuting with the adjoint action. By
`suTensor.eq_smul_id_of_commute_adjRep` that endomorphism is scalar, and the invariant tensors are
the multiples of the unit tensor of the adjoint color, `∑ λ_a ⊗ λ_a / 2` (B).

For equivariant maps out of these tensors the invariants of the range reduce to `⊥` for one
adjoint index and to the image of the unit tensor for two (C). Families indexed by the Gell-Mann
labels are turned into maps by `adjMap` and `adjPairMap`, and for two indices the image of twice
the unit tensor is the trace contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]` (D).

## ii. Key results

- `suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_adj` : an invariant tensor with one adjoint index is zero.
- `suTensor.exists_eq_smul_unitTensor_of_invariant_adjPair` : an invariant tensor with two adjoint
  indices is a multiple of the unit tensor.
- `suTensor.invariantReductionToTrace` : the reduction of the invariants of the span of a family
  with two adjoint indices to the trace contraction.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. One adjoint index
- B. Two adjoint indices
- C. The invariants of equivariant maps
- D. Maps from components

## iv. References

* None.

## B. Two adjoint indices
## C. The invariants of equivariant maps
## D. Maps from components

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_adjRep_eq_self
declarations.doc:
An invariant element of the complexified Lie algebra is zero: its matrix commutes with every
element of `SU(N)`, so it is a scalar, and its trace vanishes.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_adjRep_eq_self {A : SUAlgebraComplexified N} (hA : ∀ g : SU N, adjRep N g A = A) :
    A = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_adj
declarations.doc: An invariant tensor with one adjoint index is zero.
declarations.statement: lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_adj (t : SuT[N, .adj]) (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : t = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.adjPairIdx
declarations.doc:
The component indices of a tensor with two adjoint indices, as the pair of their Gell-Mann
labels.
declarations.statement: def adjPairIdx : ComponentIdx (S := suTensor N) ![.adj, .adj] ≃ (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N)

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_adjPair
declarations.doc:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with two adjoint indices: the matrix of components
`C` is moved to `M C Mᵀ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_smul_adjPair (g : SU N) (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj])
    (n : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) (adjPairIdx.symm n)
      = ∑ x, ∑ y, adjMatrix g (n 0) x * adjMatrix g (n 1) y
        * (Tensor.basis _).repr t (adjPairIdx.symm ![x, y])

declarations.name: suTensor.adjUnitTensor
declarations.doc: The unit tensor of the adjoint color, `∑ λ_a ⊗ λ_a / 2`, with two adjoint indices.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def adjUnitTensor : SuT[N, .adj, .adj]

declarations.name: suTensor.adjUnitTensor_invariant
declarations.doc: The unit tensor of the adjoint color is invariant.
declarations.statement: lemma adjUnitTensor_invariant (g : SU N) : g • adjUnitTensor N = adjUnitTensor N

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_adjUnitTensor
declarations.doc:
The components of the unit tensor of the adjoint color: `δ / 2`, the Gell-Mann matrices
being orthogonal with `tr (λ_a λ_b) = 2 δ_ab`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_adjUnitTensor (n : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (adjUnitTensor N) (adjPairIdx.symm n)
      = if n 0 = n 1 then 1 / 2 else 0

declarations.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_adjUnitTensor_of_invariant
declarations.doc:
An invariant tensor with two adjoint indices is a multiple of the unit tensor of the adjoint
color. Its matrix of components commutes with the matrices of the adjoint action, so it is the
matrix of an endomorphism commuting with the adjoint action, which is scalar.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_eq_smul_adjUnitTensor_of_invariant (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj])
    (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • adjUnitTensor N

declarations.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_of_isEquivariant_adj
declarations.doc:
For an equivariant map out of the tensors with one adjoint index, the invariants of the range
reduce to `⊥`.

declarations.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToAdjUnitImage
declarations.doc:
For an equivariant map `f` out of the tensors with two adjoint indices, the invariants of the
range reduce to the span of the image of the unit tensor.

declarations.name: suTensor.adjIdx
declarations.doc: The component indices of a tensor with one adjoint index, as its Gell-Mann label.
declarations.statement: def adjIdx : ComponentIdx (S := suTensor N) ![.adj] ≃ GellMann.Index N

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMap
declarations.doc:
The linear map out of the tensors with one adjoint index sending the basis tensor with label
`a` to `T a`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def adjMap (T : GellMann.Index N → B) : SuT[N, .adj] →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMap_smul_of_law
declarations.doc:
A linear map moving a family indexed by one adjoint label by the matrix of the adjoint action
of `g` intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjMap_smul_of_law (T : GellMann.Index N → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ a : GellMann.Index N, σ (T a) = ∑ b, adjMatrix g b a • T b) (t : SuT[N, .adj]) :
    σ (adjMap T t) = adjMap T (g • t)

declarations.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_adjMap
declarations.doc:
The map of a family indexed by one adjoint label is equivariant when the family moves by the
matrix of the adjoint action, the summed label first.
declarations.statement:
lemma isEquivariant_adjMap (T : GellMann.Index N → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (a : GellMann.Index N), ρ g (T a) = ∑ b, adjMatrix g b a • T b) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.adj] ρ (adjMap T)

declarations.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_span_of_adjMap
declarations.doc:
For a family indexed by one adjoint label whose map is equivariant, the invariants of the
span of the family reduce to `⊥`.

declarations.name: suTensor.adjPairMap
declarations.doc:
The linear map out of the tensors with two adjoint indices sending the basis tensor with
labels `n` to `T n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def adjPairMap (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B) :
    SuT[N, .adj, .adj] →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: suTensor.adjPairMap_two_smul_adjUnitTensor
declarations.doc: The map of a family sends twice the unit tensor to the trace contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjPairMap_two_smul_adjUnitTensor (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B) :
    adjPairMap T ((2 : ℂ) • adjUnitTensor N) = ∑ a, T ![a, a]

declarations.name: suTensor.adjPairMap_smul_of_law
declarations.doc:
A linear map moving a family indexed by two adjoint labels by the matrix of the adjoint
action of `g` on each label intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjPairMap_smul_of_law (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N, σ (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N, (adjMatrix g (a 0) (l 0) * adjMatrix g (a 1) (l 1)) • T a)
    (t : SuT[N, .adj, .adj]) :
    σ (adjPairMap T t) = adjPairMap T (g • t)

declarations.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_adjPairMap
declarations.doc:
The map of a family indexed by two adjoint labels is equivariant when the family moves by the
matrix of the adjoint action on each label, the summed label first.
declarations.statement:
lemma isEquivariant_adjPairMap (T : (Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → GellMann.Index N, (adjMatrix g (a 0) (l 0) * adjMatrix g (a 1) (l 1)) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.adj, .adj] ρ (adjPairMap T)

declarations.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToTrace
declarations.doc:
For a family indexed by two adjoint labels whose map is equivariant, the invariants of the
span of the family reduce to the span of the trace contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.

modules.title: Elements of `SU(N)` in a coordinate plane, and what commutes with them
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

For two distinct coordinates `p` and `q`, an element `U` of `SU(2)` acts on the plane they span
and fixes the other coordinates: this is `SU.planeEmbed p q`, a group homomorphism from `SU(2)`
to `SU(N)` (A, B). Writing `P` for the inclusion of the plane, the embedded element is
`1 + P (U - 1) Pᵀ`, and conjugating `P M Pᵀ` by it gives `P (U M U†) Pᵀ`, so the action on the
matrices supported on the plane is computed in `SU(2)`.

Three elements of `SU(2)` do all the work: a diagonal phase `diag (u, ū)`, the rotation by a
quarter turn, and the rotation by an eighth of a turn. Embedded in every plane, they force a
matrix commuting with all of `SU(N)` to be scalar (C), and a linear endomorphism of the
complexified Lie algebra `ℂ ⊗[ℝ] su(N)` commuting with the adjoint action to be scalar (D); the
latter is computed on the matrices `adjMat A`, which identify the complexified Lie algebra with the
traceless complex matrices. These are the two facts behind the
classification of the invariant tensors of `SU(N)` with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental
index, and with one or two adjoint indices.

## ii. Key results

- `SU.planeEmbed` : `SU(2)` acting on the plane of two coordinates, as a subgroup of `SU(N)`.
- `SU.eq_smul_one_of_commute` : a matrix commuting with `SU(N)` is scalar.
- `suTensor.eq_smul_id_of_commute_adjRep` : an endomorphism of the complexified Lie algebra
  commuting with the adjoint action is scalar.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The plane matrices
- B. The plane embedding of `SU(2)`
- C. Matrices commuting with `SU(N)`
- D. Endomorphisms of the complexified Lie algebra commuting with `SU(N)`

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The plane matrices
## B. The plane embedding of `SU(2)`

## C. Matrices commuting with `SU(N)`

The diagonal phase `diag (i, -i)` in the plane of `p` and `q` negates the entries at `(p, q)`
and `(q, p)` of a matrix it commutes with, and the quarter turn exchanges the diagonal entries
at `p` and `q`.
## D. Endomorphisms of the complexified Lie algebra commuting with `SU(N)`

declarations.name: SU.planeInclusion
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of the plane of the coordinates `p` and `q`: the `N × 2` matrix whose columns
are the basis vectors `e_p` and `e_q`.
declarations.statement: def planeInclusion (p q : Fin N) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin 2) ℂ

declarations.name: SU.planeInclusion_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma planeInclusion_apply (p q : Fin N) (x : Fin N) (i : Fin 2) :
    planeInclusion p q x i = if x = ![p, q] i then 1 else 0

declarations.name: SU.planeInclusion_transpose_mul
declarations.doc: The inclusion of the plane of two distinct coordinates is an isometry.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeInclusion_transpose_mul {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * planeInclusion p q = 1

declarations.name: SU.conjTranspose_planeInclusion
declarations.doc: The inclusion of the plane has real entries, so its conjugate transpose is its transpose.
declarations.statement:
lemma conjTranspose_planeInclusion (p q : Fin N) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᴴ = (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

declarations.name: SU.planeMatrix
declarations.doc:
The matrix acting as `U` on the plane of the coordinates `p` and `q` and as the identity on
the other coordinates.
declarations.statement: def planeMatrix (p q : Fin N) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ

declarations.name: SU.planeMatrix_one
declarations.doc: The plane matrix of the identity is the identity.
declarations.statement: lemma planeMatrix_one : planeMatrix p q 1 = 1

declarations.name: SU.planeMatrix_mul
declarations.doc: The plane matrices multiply as the matrices on the plane.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeMatrix_mul (hpq : p ≠ q) (U V : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q U * planeMatrix p q V = planeMatrix p q (U * V)

declarations.name: SU.conjTranspose_planeMatrix
declarations.doc:
The conjugate transpose of a plane matrix is the plane matrix of the conjugate
transpose.
declarations.statement:
lemma conjTranspose_planeMatrix (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ = planeMatrix p q Uᴴ

declarations.name: SU.det_planeMatrix
declarations.doc: A plane matrix has the determinant of the matrix on the plane.
declarations.statement:
lemma det_planeMatrix (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (planeMatrix p q U).det = U.det

declarations.name: SU.planeMatrix_mul_planeInclusion
declarations.doc: A plane matrix moves the plane as the matrix on the plane does.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeMatrix_mul_planeInclusion (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q U * planeInclusion p q = planeInclusion p q * U

declarations.name: SU.transpose_planeInclusion_mul_planeMatrix
declarations.doc:
The transpose of the inclusion of the plane intertwines a plane matrix with the matrix on
the plane.
declarations.statement:
lemma transpose_planeInclusion_mul_planeMatrix (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * planeMatrix p q U = U * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

declarations.name: SU.planeMatrix_conj
declarations.doc: Conjugating a matrix supported on the plane by a plane matrix conjugates it on the plane.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeMatrix_conj (hpq : p ≠ q) (U M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q U * (planeInclusion p q * M * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ) * (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ
      = planeInclusion p q * (U * M * Uᴴ) * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

declarations.name: SU.planeBlock_conj
declarations.doc:
The block on the plane of a matrix conjugated by a plane matrix is the conjugate of its
block.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeBlock_conj (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) :
    (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * (planeMatrix p q U * C * (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ) * planeInclusion p q
      = U * ((planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q) * Uᴴ

declarations.name: SU.planeBlock_apply
declarations.doc:
The entries of the block on the plane are the entries of the matrix at the two
coordinates.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeBlock_apply (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (i j : Fin 2) :
    ((planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q) i j = C (![p, q] i) (![p, q] j)

declarations.name: SU.planeMatrix_diagonal
declarations.doc: A plane matrix of a diagonal matrix is diagonal.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeMatrix_diagonal (hpq : p ≠ q) (a b : ℂ) :
    planeMatrix p q (diagonal ![a, b])
      = diagonal fun x => if x = p then a else if x = q then b else 1

declarations.name: SU.planeEmbed
declarations.doc:
`SU(2)` acting on the plane of the coordinates `p` and `q` and trivially on the others: a
homomorphism from `SU(2)` to `SU(N)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def planeEmbed (p q : Fin N) (hpq : p ≠ q) : SU 2 →* SU N

declarations.name: SU.planeEmbed_val
declarations.statement: lemma planeEmbed_val (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : SU 2) : (planeEmbed p q hpq U).1 = planeMatrix p q U.1

declarations.name: SU.diagPhase
declarations.doc: The diagonal element `diag (u, ū)` of `SU(2)`, for a complex number `u` of modulus one.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def diagPhase (u : ℂ) (hu : u * star u = 1) : SU 2

declarations.name: SU.diagPhase_val
declarations.statement:
lemma diagPhase_val (u : ℂ) (hu : u * star u = 1) :
    (diagPhase u hu).1 = diagonal ![u, star u]

declarations.name: SU.rotation
declarations.doc: The rotation `!![c, -s; s, c]` of `SU(2)`, for real `c` and `s` with `c² + s² = 1`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def rotation (c s : ℝ) (h : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : SU 2

declarations.name: SU.rotation_val
declarations.statement:
lemma rotation_val (c s : ℝ) (h : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (rotation c s h).1 = !![(c : ℂ), -s; s, c]

declarations.name: SU.planeBlock_eq_of_conj_eq
declarations.doc:
A matrix fixed by conjugation by a plane matrix has its block on the plane fixed by
conjugation by the matrix on the plane.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeBlock_eq_of_conj_eq (hpq : p ≠ q) {U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ}
    {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hC : planeMatrix p q U * C * (planeMatrix p q U)ᴴ = C) :
    U * ((planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q) * Uᴴ
      = (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ * C * planeInclusion p q

declarations.name: SU.conj_eq_of_commute
declarations.doc: A matrix commuting with every element of `SU(N)` is fixed by conjugation.
declarations.statement:
lemma conj_eq_of_commute {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hC : ∀ g : SU N, g.1 * C = C * g.1)
    (g : SU N) : g.1 * C * g.1ᴴ = C

declarations.name: SU.apply_eq_of_commute
declarations.doc:
A matrix commuting with every element of `SU(N)` is diagonal, with equal diagonal
entries.
declarations.statement:
lemma apply_eq_of_commute {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hC : ∀ g : SU N, g.1 * C = C * g.1)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) : C p q = 0 ∧ C p p = C q q

declarations.name: SU.eq_smul_one_of_commute
declarations.doc: A matrix commuting with every element of `SU(N)` is scalar.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_smul_one_of_commute {C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ}
    (hC : ∀ g : SU N, g.1 * C = C * g.1) : ∃ z : ℂ, C = z • 1

declarations.name: suTensor.offDiag
declarations.doc:
The matrix unit at `(x, y)` off the diagonal, as an element of the complexified Lie algebra,
and zero on the diagonal.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def offDiag (x y : Fin N) : SUAlgebraComplexified N

declarations.name: suTensor.diagDiff
declarations.doc:
The difference of the diagonal matrix units at `x` and at `y`, as an element of the
complexified Lie algebra.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def diagDiff (x y : Fin N) : SUAlgebraComplexified N

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMat_offDiag
declarations.statement:
lemma adjMat_offDiag (x y : Fin N) :
    adjMat N (offDiag x y) = if x = y then 0 else single x y 1

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMat_offDiag_of_ne
declarations.statement: lemma adjMat_offDiag_of_ne {x y : Fin N} (h : x ≠ y) : adjMat N (offDiag x y) = single x y 1

declarations.name: suTensor.offDiag_self
declarations.statement: lemma offDiag_self (x : Fin N) : offDiag x x = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMat_diagDiff
declarations.statement: lemma adjMat_diagDiff (x y : Fin N) : adjMat N (diagDiff x y) = single x x 1 - single y y 1

declarations.name: suTensor.diagDiff_self
declarations.statement: lemma diagDiff_self (x : Fin N) : diagDiff x x = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.planeInclusion_single
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of the plane carries the matrix units of the plane to those of the
coordinates.
declarations.statement:
lemma planeInclusion_single (p q : Fin N) (i j : Fin 2) :
    planeInclusion p q * single i j (1 : ℂ) * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ
      = single (![p, q] i) (![p, q] j) 1

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMat_adjRep_planeEmbed
declarations.doc:
The adjoint action of an element of `SU(2)` embedded in a plane on a matrix supported on the
plane.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjMat_adjRep_planeEmbed {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) (U : SU 2)
    (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hA : adjMat N A = planeInclusion p q * M * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ) :
    adjMat N (adjRep N (planeEmbed p q hpq U) A)
      = planeInclusion p q * (U.1 * M * U.1ᴴ) * (planeInclusion p q)ᵀ

declarations.name: suTensor.sqrtI
declarations.doc: The phase `(1 + i) / √2`, a square root of `i` of modulus one.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def sqrtI : ℂ

declarations.name: suTensor.sqrt_two_mul_sqrt_two
declarations.statement: lemma sqrt_two_mul_sqrt_two : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) = 2

declarations.name: suTensor.sqrt_two_ne_zero
declarations.statement: lemma sqrt_two_ne_zero : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0

declarations.name: suTensor.star_sqrtI
declarations.statement: lemma star_sqrtI : star sqrtI = (1 - Complex.I) / (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)

declarations.name: suTensor.sqrtI_mul_star
declarations.statement: lemma sqrtI_mul_star : sqrtI * star sqrtI = 1

declarations.name: suTensor.sqrtI_mul_self
declarations.statement: lemma sqrtI_mul_self : sqrtI * sqrtI = Complex.I

declarations.name: suTensor.star_sqrtI_mul_self
declarations.statement: lemma star_sqrtI_mul_self : star sqrtI * star sqrtI = -Complex.I

declarations.name: suTensor.sqrtI_ne_I
declarations.statement: lemma sqrtI_ne_I : sqrtI ≠ Complex.I

declarations.name: suTensor.star_sqrtI_ne_I
declarations.statement: lemma star_sqrtI_ne_I : star sqrtI ≠ Complex.I

declarations.name: suTensor.adjMat_adjRep_apply_of_diagonal
declarations.doc:
The adjoint action of a diagonal matrix of `SU(N)` scales the entry at `(x, y)` by
`d x * star (d y)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjMat_adjRep_apply_of_diagonal {g : SU N} {d : Fin N → ℂ} (hg : g.1 = diagonal d)
    (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (x y : Fin N) :
    adjMat N (adjRep N g A) x y = d x * adjMat N A x y * star (d y)

declarations.name: suTensor.map_offDiag_eq_smul
declarations.doc:
For `p ≠ q`, an endomorphism commuting with the adjoint action sends the matrix unit at
`(p, q)` to a multiple of itself. The phase `diag (ω, ω̄)` in the plane of `p` and `q`, with
`ω² = i`, multiplies that matrix unit by `i` and no other entry by `i`.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_offDiag_eq_smul (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    L (offDiag p q) = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q • offDiag p q

declarations.name: suTensor.adjRep_quarterTurn_offDiag
declarations.doc:
The quarter turn in the plane of `p` and `q` sends the matrix unit at `(p, q)` to minus the
one at `(q, p)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjRep_quarterTurn_offDiag {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    adjRep N (planeEmbed p q hpq (rotation 0 1 (by norm_num))) (offDiag p q) = -offDiag q p

declarations.name: suTensor.coeff_offDiag_swap
declarations.doc: The coefficients of the matrix units at `(p, q)` and at `(q, p)` agree.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_offDiag_swap (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    adjMat N (L (offDiag q p)) q p = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q

declarations.name: suTensor.invSqrtTwo
declarations.doc: The cosine of an eighth of a turn, `1 / √2`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def invSqrtTwo : ℝ

declarations.name: suTensor.invSqrtTwo_sq_add
declarations.statement: lemma invSqrtTwo_sq_add : invSqrtTwo ^ 2 + invSqrtTwo ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: suTensor.invSqrtTwo_mul_self
declarations.statement: lemma invSqrtTwo_mul_self : (invSqrtTwo : ℂ) * invSqrtTwo = 1 / 2

declarations.name: suTensor.adjRep_eighthTurn_offDiag
declarations.doc:
The eighth turn in the plane of `p` and `q` sends the sum of the matrix units at `(p, q)`
and at `(q, p)` to minus the difference of the diagonal matrix units at `p` and at `q`.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjRep_eighthTurn_offDiag {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    adjRep N (planeEmbed p q hpq (rotation invSqrtTwo invSqrtTwo invSqrtTwo_sq_add))
      (offDiag p q + offDiag q p) = -diagDiff p q

declarations.name: suTensor.map_diagDiff_eq_smul
declarations.doc:
For `p ≠ q`, an endomorphism commuting with the adjoint action scales the difference of the
diagonal matrix units at `p` and at `q` by the coefficient of the matrix unit at `(p, q)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_diagDiff_eq_smul (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    L (diagDiff p q) = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q • diagDiff p q

declarations.name: suTensor.coeff_offDiag_eq
declarations.doc:
For distinct `p`, `q` and `r`, the coefficients of the matrix units at `(p, q)` and at
`(p, r)` agree: the difference of the diagonal units at `p` and `r` is the sum of those at `p`
and `q` and at `q` and `r`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_offDiag_eq (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) {p q r : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpr : p ≠ r)
    (hqr : q ≠ r) : adjMat N (L (offDiag p r)) p r = adjMat N (L (offDiag p q)) p q

declarations.name: suTensor.exists_coeff_offDiag_eq
declarations.doc:
All the matrix units off the diagonal have the same coefficient under an endomorphism
commuting with the adjoint action.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_coeff_offDiag_eq (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) :
    ∃ μ : ℂ, ∀ x y : Fin N, x ≠ y → adjMat N (L (offDiag x y)) x y = μ

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_sum_offDiag_add_sum_diagDiff
declarations.doc:
An element of the complexified Lie algebra is the combination of the entries of its matrix off
the diagonal against the matrix
units, and of its diagonal entries against the differences of the diagonal matrix units at a
fixed coordinate.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_sum_offDiag_add_sum_diagDiff (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N) (x₀ : Fin N) :
    A = ∑ x, ∑ y, adjMat N A x y • offDiag x y + ∑ x, adjMat N A x x • diagDiff x x₀

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_smul_id_of_commute_adjRep
declarations.doc:
An endomorphism of the complexified Lie algebra commuting with the adjoint action of every
element of `SU(N)` is scalar: a form of Schur's lemma for the adjoint representation.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_smul_id_of_commute_adjRep (hL : ∀ (g : SU N) (A : SUAlgebraComplexified N),
    L (adjRep N g A) = adjRep N g (L A)) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, L = z • LinearMap.id

modules.title: Invariants of two fundamental or two anti-fundamental indices of `SU(N)`
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The tensors with `n` fundamental indices, or with `n` anti-fundamental indices, have the tuples
`Fin n → Fin N` as component indices, and `g` moves the components by one factor of `g`, or of
its complex conjugate, per index (A).

For `SU(2)` the invariant tensors with two fundamental indices, and those with two
anti-fundamental indices, are the multiples of the antisymmetric symbol `ε` (B). The phase
`diag (i, -i)` negates the two diagonal components, and the quarter turn sends the component
`(0, 1)` to minus the component `(1, 0)`. For `N ≥ 3` there are none at all (C): the centre element
`ω 1`, with `ω` a primitive `N`-th root of unity, scales every component by `ω² ≠ 1`, or by its
conjugate.

Families indexed by `Fin n → Fin N` are turned into maps by `fundMap` and `antiFundMap`, and for
`SU(2)` the invariants of the span of such a family with two indices reduce to the epsilon
contraction `T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]` (D).

## ii. Key results

- `suTensor.epsilonFund`, `suTensor.epsilonAntiFund` : the antisymmetric symbols of `SU(2)`.
- `suTensor.exists_eq_smul_epsilonFund_of_invariant` : the invariant tensors with two fundamental
  indices of `SU(2)`, and its anti-fundamental twin.
- `suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_fundPair` : for `N ≥ 3` there are none, and its
  anti-fundamental twin.
- `suTensor.invariantReductionToEpsilonFund` : the reduction of the invariants of the span of a
  family to the epsilon contraction, and its anti-fundamental twin.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Tensors with fundamental or with anti-fundamental indices
- B. Two indices of `SU(2)`: the antisymmetric symbol
- C. Two indices of `SU(N)` for `N ≥ 3`: no invariants
- D. Maps from components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. Tensors with fundamental or with anti-fundamental indices
## B. Two indices of `SU(2)`: the antisymmetric symbol
## C. Two indices of `SU(N)` for `N ≥ 3`: no invariants
## D. Maps from components

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_fund
declarations.doc:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with `n` fundamental indices: one factor of `g` per
index.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_smul_fund {n : ℕ} (g : SU N) (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .fund)
    (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) φ
      = ∑ ψ : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, g.1 (φ i) (ψ i)) * (Tensor.basis _).repr t ψ

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_antiFund
declarations.doc:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with `n` anti-fundamental indices: one factor of the
complex conjugate of `g` per index.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_smul_antiFund {n : ℕ} (g : SU N)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .antiFund) (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) φ = ∑ ψ : Fin n → Fin N,
      (∏ i, starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (φ i) (ψ i))) * (Tensor.basis _).repr t ψ

declarations.name: suTensor.sum_fin_two_arrow
declarations.doc: A sum over pairs of labels is a double sum.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_fin_two_arrow {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → M) :
    ∑ ψ : Fin 2 → Fin N, F ψ = ∑ x, ∑ y, F ![x, y]

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonFund
declarations.doc: The antisymmetric symbol `ε^{ab}` with two fundamental indices of `SU(2)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def epsilonFund : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonAntiFund
declarations.doc: The antisymmetric symbol `ε_{ab}` with two anti-fundamental indices of `SU(2)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def epsilonAntiFund : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonFund
declarations.doc: The components of the antisymmetric symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonFund (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonFund φ
      = (if φ = ![0, 1] then 1 else 0) - (if φ = ![1, 0] then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonAntiFund
declarations.doc: The components of the antisymmetric symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonAntiFund (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonAntiFund φ
      = (if φ = ![0, 1] then 1 else 0) - (if φ = ![1, 0] then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_smul_epsilon_of_fixed
declarations.doc:
A function of two labels fixed by a diagonal matrix with entries squaring to `-1` and by
the quarter turn, acting by one factor of `M g` per label, is a multiple of the antisymmetric
symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_smul_epsilon_of_fixed (M : SU 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) {u v : ℂ}
    (hu : u * u = -1) (hv : v * v = -1)
    (hD : M (diagPhase Complex.I (by simp)) = diagonal ![u, v])
    (hR : M (rotation 0 1 (by norm_num)) = !![0, -1; 1, 0]) {c : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → ℂ}
    (hc : ∀ (g : SU 2) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2),
      c φ = ∑ ψ : Fin 2 → Fin 2, (∏ i, M g (φ i) (ψ i)) * c ψ) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2) :
    c φ = c ![0, 1] * ((if φ = ![0, 1] then 1 else 0) - (if φ = ![1, 0] then 1 else 0))

declarations.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_epsilonFund_of_invariant
declarations.doc:
An invariant tensor with two fundamental indices of `SU(2)` is a multiple of the
antisymmetric symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_eq_smul_epsilonFund_of_invariant (t : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund)
    (ht : ∀ g : SU 2, g • t = t) : ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • epsilonFund

declarations.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_epsilonAntiFund_of_invariant
declarations.doc:
An invariant tensor with two anti-fundamental indices of `SU(2)` is a multiple of the
antisymmetric symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_eq_smul_epsilonAntiFund_of_invariant
    (t : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund) (ht : ∀ g : SU 2, g • t = t) :
    ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • epsilonAntiFund

declarations.name: suTensor.det_fin_two_eq_one
declarations.doc: The determinant of an element of `SU(2)`, written out.
declarations.statement: lemma det_fin_two_eq_one (g : SU 2) : g.1 0 0 * g.1 1 1 - g.1 0 1 * g.1 1 0 = 1

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonFund_invariant
declarations.doc:
The antisymmetric symbol with two fundamental indices is invariant: `g ⊗ g` scales it by
`det g = 1`.
declarations.statement: lemma epsilonFund_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonFund = epsilonFund

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonAntiFund_invariant
declarations.doc:
The antisymmetric symbol with two anti-fundamental indices is invariant: `ḡ ⊗ ḡ` scales it
by the conjugate of `det g = 1`.
declarations.statement: lemma epsilonAntiFund_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonAntiFund = epsilonAntiFund

declarations.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity
declarations.doc: The primitive `N`-th root of unity `exp (2 π i / N)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def rootOfUnity (N : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity_isPrimitiveRoot
declarations.statement: lemma rootOfUnity_isPrimitiveRoot (hN : N ≠ 0) : IsPrimitiveRoot (rootOfUnity N) N

declarations.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity_mul_star
declarations.statement: lemma rootOfUnity_mul_star : rootOfUnity N * star (rootOfUnity N) = 1

declarations.name: suTensor.centre
declarations.doc: The centre element `ω 1` of `SU(N)`, for `ω` the primitive `N`-th root of unity.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def centre (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) : SU N

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_centre_smul_fund
declarations.doc: The centre element scales the components of a tensor with two fundamental indices by `ω²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_centre_smul_fund (hN : N ≠ 0) (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund)
    (φ : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (centre N hN • t) φ
      = rootOfUnity N ^ 2 * (Tensor.basis _).repr t φ

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_centre_smul_antiFund
declarations.doc:
The centre element scales the components of a tensor with two anti-fundamental indices by
`ω̄²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_centre_smul_antiFund (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (centre N hN • t) φ
      = starRingEnd ℂ (rootOfUnity N) ^ 2 * (Tensor.basis _).repr t φ

declarations.name: suTensor.rootOfUnity_sq_ne_one
declarations.statement: lemma rootOfUnity_sq_ne_one (hN : 3 ≤ N) : rootOfUnity N ^ 2 ≠ 1

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_fundPair
declarations.doc:
For `N ≥ 3` the only invariant tensor with two fundamental indices is zero: the centre
element scales it by `ω² ≠ 1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_fundPair (hN : 3 ≤ N) (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .fund)
    (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : t = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_invariant_antiFundPair
declarations.doc:
For `N ≥ 3` the only invariant tensor with two anti-fundamental indices is zero: the centre
element scales it by `ω̄² ≠ 1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_invariant_antiFundPair (hN : 3 ≤ N)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin 2 => .antiFund) (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) :
    t = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.fundMap
declarations.doc:
The linear map out of the tensors with `n` fundamental indices sending the basis tensor with
labels `l` to `T l`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) :
    (suTensor N).Tensor (fun _ : Fin n => .fund) →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: suTensor.antiFundMap
declarations.doc:
The linear map out of the tensors with `n` anti-fundamental indices sending the basis tensor
with labels `l` to `T l`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def antiFundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) :
    (suTensor N).Tensor (fun _ : Fin n => .antiFund) →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: suTensor.fundMap_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma fundMap_basis {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) (l : Fin n → Fin N) :
    fundMap T (Tensor.basis (S := suTensor N) (fun _ : Fin n => Color.fund) l) = T l

declarations.name: suTensor.antiFundMap_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma antiFundMap_basis {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) (l : Fin n → Fin N) :
    antiFundMap T (Tensor.basis (S := suTensor N) (fun _ : Fin n => Color.antiFund) l) = T l

declarations.name: suTensor.fundMap_smul_of_law
declarations.doc:
A linear map moving a family with `n` fundamental labels by one factor of `g` per label
intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fundMap_smul_of_law {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin n → Fin N, σ (T l) = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, g.1 (a i) (l i)) • T a)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .fund) :
    σ (fundMap T t) = fundMap T (g • t)

declarations.name: suTensor.antiFundMap_smul_of_law
declarations.doc:
A linear map moving a family with `n` anti-fundamental labels by one factor of the complex
conjugate of `g` per label intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`.
declarations.statement:
lemma antiFundMap_smul_of_law {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin n → Fin N, σ (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a i) (l i))) • T a)
    (t : (suTensor N).Tensor fun _ : Fin n => .antiFund) :
    σ (antiFundMap T t) = antiFundMap T (g • t)

declarations.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_fundMap
declarations.doc:
The map of a family with `n` fundamental labels is equivariant when the family moves by one
factor of `g` per label, the summed label first.
declarations.statement:
lemma isEquivariant_fundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin n → Fin N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, g.1 (a i) (l i)) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .fund) ρ (fundMap T)

declarations.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_antiFundMap
declarations.doc:
The map of a family with `n` anti-fundamental labels is equivariant when the family moves by
one factor of the complex conjugate of `g` per label, the summed label first.
declarations.statement:
lemma isEquivariant_antiFundMap {n : ℕ} (T : (Fin n → Fin N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin n → Fin N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin N, (∏ i, starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a i) (l i))) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .antiFund) ρ (antiFundMap T)

declarations.name: suTensor.fundMap_epsilonFund
declarations.doc:
The map of a family with two fundamental labels sends the antisymmetric symbol to the
epsilon contraction.
declarations.statement:
lemma fundMap_epsilonFund (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → B) :
    fundMap T epsilonFund = T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]

declarations.name: suTensor.antiFundMap_epsilonAntiFund
declarations.doc:
The map of a family with two anti-fundamental labels sends the antisymmetric symbol to the
epsilon contraction.
declarations.statement:
lemma antiFundMap_epsilonAntiFund (T : (Fin 2 → Fin 2) → B) :
    antiFundMap T epsilonAntiFund = T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]

declarations.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToEpsilonFund
declarations.doc:
For a family with two fundamental labels of `SU(2)` whose map is equivariant, the invariants
of the span reduce to the span of the epsilon contraction `T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]`.

declarations.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToEpsilonAntiFund
declarations.doc:
For a family with two anti-fundamental labels of `SU(2)` whose map is equivariant, the
invariants of the span reduce to the span of the epsilon contraction
`T ![0, 1] - T ![1, 0]`.

declarations.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_span_of_fundMap
declarations.doc:
For `N ≥ 3` and a family with two fundamental labels whose map is equivariant, the
invariants of the span reduce to `⊥`.

declarations.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_bot_span_of_antiFundMap
declarations.doc:
For `N ≥ 3` and a family with two anti-fundamental labels whose map is equivariant, the
invariants of the span reduce to `⊥`.

modules.title: Invariants of a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index of `SU(N)`
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The invariant tensors of `SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund]` are the multiples of the Kronecker delta
`δᵃ_b`, the unit tensor `delta N` of the anti-fundamental color (A, B). The components of a
tensor with these indices form a matrix `C`, which `g` moves to `g C g⁻¹`, so the components of
an invariant tensor commute with every element of `SU(N)` and are scalar
(`SU.eq_smul_one_of_commute`).

For an equivariant map `f` out of these tensors, the invariants of `LinearMap.range f ⊔ S`, for
`S` a stable submodule, reduce to the line through `f (delta N)` (C). A family `T` of vectors
indexed by `Fin 2 → Fin N`, a fundamental index first, is the map `fundAntiFundMap T`, equivariant
exactly when `T` obeys the transformation law of the components (D), and `f (delta N)` is then
the contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.

## ii. Key results

- `suTensor.delta` : the Kronecker delta.
- `suTensor.exists_eq_smul_delta_of_invariant` : the invariant tensors are its multiples.
- `suTensor.invariantReductionToDelta` : the reduction of the invariants of the span of a family
  to the delta contraction.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The Kronecker delta
- B. The invariant tensors
- C. The invariants of an equivariant map
- D. Maps from components

## iv. References

* None.

## B. The invariant tensors
## C. The invariants of an equivariant map
## D. Maps from components

declarations.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundIdx
declarations.doc:
The component indices of a tensor with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index, as the
pair of their labels.
declarations.statement: def fundAntiFundIdx : ComponentIdx (S := suTensor N) ![.fund, .antiFund] ≃ (Fin 2 → Fin N)

declarations.name: suTensor.delta
declarations.doc:
The Kronecker delta `δᵃ_b`, the unit tensor of the anti-fundamental color, with a
fundamental and an anti-fundamental index.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def delta : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund]

declarations.name: suTensor.delta_invariant
declarations.doc: The Kronecker delta is invariant.
declarations.statement: lemma delta_invariant (g : SU N) : g • delta N = delta N

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_delta
declarations.doc: The components of the Kronecker delta.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_delta (n : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (delta N) (fundAntiFundIdx.symm n) = if n 0 = n 1 then 1 else 0

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_smul_fundAntiFund
declarations.doc:
The components of `g • t` for a tensor with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index:
the matrix of components `C` is moved to `g C g⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_smul_fundAntiFund (g : SU N) (t : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund])
    (n : Fin 2 → Fin N) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (g • t) (fundAntiFundIdx.symm n)
      = ∑ x, ∑ y, g.1 (n 0) x * (g⁻¹).1 y (n 1)
        * (Tensor.basis _).repr t (fundAntiFundIdx.symm ![x, y])

declarations.name: suTensor.exists_eq_smul_delta_of_invariant
declarations.doc:
An invariant tensor with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index is a multiple of the
Kronecker delta: its matrix of components commutes with every element of `SU(N)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_eq_smul_delta_of_invariant (t : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund])
    (ht : ∀ g : SU N, g • t = t) : ∃ a : ℂ, t = a • delta N

declarations.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToDeltaImage
declarations.doc:
For an equivariant map `f` out of the tensors with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental
index, the invariants of the range of `f` reduce to the span of the image `f (delta N)` of the
Kronecker delta.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def invariantReductionToDeltaImage
    (hf : (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.fund, .antiFund] ρ f) :
    InvariantReductionToSpan (fun g : SU N => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f)

declarations.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundMap
declarations.doc:
The linear map out of the tensors with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index sending
the basis tensor with labels `n` to `T n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fundAntiFundMap (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B) :
    SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund] →ₗ[ℂ] B

declarations.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundMap_delta
declarations.doc: The map of a family sends the Kronecker delta to the contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fundAntiFundMap_delta (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B) :
    fundAntiFundMap T (delta N) = ∑ a, T ![a, a]

declarations.name: suTensor.fundAntiFundMap_smul_of_law
declarations.doc:
A linear map moving a family as `g` moves the components of a tensor with a fundamental and an
anti-fundamental index intertwines the map of the family with the action of `g`: a factor of `g`
on the first index and of its complex conjugate on the second, the summed index first.
declarations.statement:
lemma fundAntiFundMap_smul_of_law (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B) {σ : B →ₗ[ℂ] B} (g : SU N)
    (hσ : ∀ l : Fin 2 → Fin N, σ (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → Fin N, (g.1 (a 0) (l 0) * starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a 1) (l 1))) • T a)
    (t : SuT[N, .fund, .antiFund]) :
    σ (fundAntiFundMap T t) = fundAntiFundMap T (g • t)

declarations.name: suTensor.isEquivariant_fundAntiFundMap
declarations.doc:
The map of a family is equivariant when the family moves as the components of a tensor
with a fundamental and an anti-fundamental index.
declarations.statement:
lemma isEquivariant_fundAntiFundMap (T : (Fin 2 → Fin N) → B)
    (hT : ∀ (g : SU N) (l : Fin 2 → Fin N), ρ g (T l)
      = ∑ a : Fin 2 → Fin N, (g.1 (a 0) (l 0) * starRingEnd ℂ (g.1 (a 1) (l 1))) • T a) :
    (suTensor N).IsEquivariant ![.fund, .antiFund] ρ (fundAntiFundMap T)

declarations.name: suTensor.invariantReductionToDelta
declarations.doc:
For a family whose map is equivariant, the invariants of the span of the family reduce to
the span of the delta contraction `∑ a, T ![a, a]`.

modules.title: Invariants of four fundamental indices of `SU(2)`
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

Four fundamental indices of `SU(2)` can be paired off by the antisymmetric symbol in three
ways, and the Schouten identity is one linear relation between them. The invariant tensors are
the combinations of the pairings `ε^{ab} ε^{cd}` and `ε^{ac} ε^{bd}`, `epsilonPair₁₂` and
`epsilonPair₁₃` (A, B).

Three elements of `SU(2)` pin the components `c` of an invariant tensor down (B). The phase
`diag (ω, ω̄)`, for `ω` a primitive eighth root of unity, scales `c l` by `ω` to the power of the
number of zeros of `l` plus seven times the number of ones, so only the six balanced components,
with two labels of each kind, survive. The quarter turn equates each balanced component with its
complement, leaving three unknowns. The eighth turn carries `c ![0, 0, 0, 0]` to a quarter of the
sum of the balanced components, which therefore vanishes. Two unknowns remain, and they are the
coefficients of the two pairings.

For an equivariant map out of these tensors, and for the map `fundMap T` of a family, the
invariants reduce to the span of the images of the two pairings (C).

## ii. Key results

- `suTensor.epsilonPair₁₂`, `suTensor.epsilonPair₁₃` : the two pairings.
- `suTensor.mem_span_epsilonPairs_of_invariant` : the invariant tensors lie in their span.
- `suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_span_epsilonContractions` : the reduction of the invariants of
  the span of a family.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The two pairings
- B. The invariant tensors
- C. The invariants of the span of a family

## iv. References

* None.

## B. The invariant tensors
## C. The invariants of the span of a family

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilon
declarations.doc: The antisymmetric symbol of `SU(2)` as a function of two labels.
declarations.statement: def epsilon (a b : Fin 2) : ℂ

declarations.name: suTensor.sum_mul_epsilon
declarations.doc: The antisymmetric symbol is invariant: `∑ g a x g b y ε x y = det g ε a b`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_mul_epsilon (g : SU 2) (a b : Fin 2) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, g.1 a x * g.1 b y * epsilon x y = epsilon a b

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₂
declarations.doc:
The pairing `ε^{ab} ε^{cd}` of the first index with the second and the third with the
fourth.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def epsilonPair₁₂ : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 4 => .fund

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₃
declarations.doc:
The pairing `ε^{ac} ε^{bd}` of the first index with the third and the second with the
fourth.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def epsilonPair₁₃ : (suTensor 2).Tensor fun _ : Fin 4 => .fund

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₂
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₂ (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonPair₁₂ l = epsilon (l 0) (l 1) * epsilon (l 2) (l 3)

declarations.name: suTensor.basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₃
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_epsilonPair₁₃ (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr epsilonPair₁₃ l = epsilon (l 0) (l 2) * epsilon (l 1) (l 3)

declarations.name: suTensor.sum_fin_four_arrow
declarations.doc: A sum over four labels is a fourfold sum.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_fin_four_arrow {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → M) :
    ∑ ψ : Fin 4 → Fin 2, F ψ = ∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ z, ∑ w, F ![x, y, z, w]

declarations.name: suTensor.sum_mul_epsilon_mul_epsilon
declarations.doc: A product of two invariant pairings of labels is invariant.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_mul_epsilon_mul_epsilon (g : SU 2) (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) (i j k m : Fin 4)
    (hijkm : ∀ ψ : Fin 4 → Fin 2, (∏ r, g.1 (l r) (ψ r))
      = g.1 (l i) (ψ i) * g.1 (l j) (ψ j) * (g.1 (l k) (ψ k) * g.1 (l m) (ψ m)))
    (F : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 4 → Fin 2) (hF : ∀ x y z w, F x y z w i = x ∧
      F x y z w j = y ∧ F x y z w k = z ∧ F x y z w m = w)
    (hsum : ∀ G : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → ℂ, ∑ ψ, G ψ = ∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ z, ∑ w, G (F x y z w)) :
    ∑ ψ : Fin 4 → Fin 2, (∏ r, g.1 (l r) (ψ r)) * (epsilon (ψ i) (ψ j) * epsilon (ψ k) (ψ m))
      = epsilon (l i) (l j) * epsilon (l k) (l m)

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₂_invariant
declarations.doc: The pairing `ε^{ab} ε^{cd}` is invariant.
declarations.statement: lemma epsilonPair₁₂_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonPair₁₂ = epsilonPair₁₂

declarations.name: suTensor.epsilonPair₁₃_invariant
declarations.doc: The pairing `ε^{ac} ε^{bd}` is invariant.
declarations.statement: lemma epsilonPair₁₃_invariant (g : SU 2) : g • epsilonPair₁₃ = epsilonPair₁₃

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_zero_of_not_dvd
declarations.doc:
The phase `diag (ω, ω̄)`, with `ω` a primitive eighth root of unity, scales the component at
`l` by `ω` to the power of the number of zeros of `l` plus seven times the number of ones, so
the component vanishes unless that power is a multiple of eight.
declarations.statement: lemma eq_zero_of_not_dvd (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) (hl : ¬ 8 ∣ ∑ i, ![1, 7] (l i)) : c l = 0

declarations.name: suTensor.quarterTurn_relations
declarations.doc: The quarter turn equates each balanced component with its complement.

declarations.name: suTensor.unbalanced_eq_zero
declarations.doc: The ten unbalanced components vanish.

declarations.name: suTensor.sum_balanced_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
The eighth turn carries the component at `![0, 0, 0, 0]` to a quarter of the sum of the
balanced components, so that sum vanishes.

declarations.name: suTensor.eq_add_of_pairings
declarations.doc:
An invariant function of four labels is a combination of the two pairings, with the
components at `![0, 1, 0, 1]` and `![0, 0, 1, 1]` as coefficients.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_add_of_pairings (l : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    c l = c ![0, 1, 0, 1] * (epsilon (l 0) (l 1) * epsilon (l 2) (l 3))
      + c ![0, 0, 1, 1] * (epsilon (l 0) (l 2) * epsilon (l 1) (l 3))

declarations.name: suTensor.mem_span_epsilonPairs_of_invariant
declarations.doc:
An invariant tensor with four fundamental indices of `SU(2)` is a combination of the two
pairings of its indices by the antisymmetric symbol.

declarations.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_span_map_epsilonPairs
declarations.doc:
For an equivariant map `f` out of the tensors with four fundamental indices of `SU(2)`, the
invariants of the range reduce to the span of the images of the two pairings.
declarations.statement:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_map_epsilonPairs
    {f : (suTensor 2).Tensor (fun _ : Fin 4 => .fund) →ₗ[ℂ] B}
    (hf : (suTensor 2).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .fund) ρ f) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SU 2 => ρ g) (LinearMap.range f)
      (Submodule.span ℂ {f epsilonPair₁₂, f epsilonPair₁₃})

declarations.name: suTensor.fundMap_epsilonPair₁₂
declarations.doc:
The map of a family sends the first pairing to the contraction pairing the first label with
the second and the third with the fourth.
declarations.statement:
lemma fundMap_epsilonPair₁₂ (T : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B) :
    fundMap T epsilonPair₁₂
      = T ![0, 1, 0, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 0, 1, 0]

declarations.name: suTensor.fundMap_epsilonPair₁₃
declarations.doc:
The map of a family sends the second pairing to the contraction pairing the first label with
the third and the second with the fourth.
declarations.statement:
lemma fundMap_epsilonPair₁₃ (T : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B) :
    fundMap T epsilonPair₁₃
      = T ![0, 0, 1, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 1, 0, 0]

declarations.name: suTensor.reducesInvariantsTo_span_epsilonContractions
declarations.doc:
For a family with four fundamental labels of `SU(2)` whose map is equivariant, the invariants
of the span of the family reduce to the span of its two epsilon contractions.
declarations.statement:
lemma reducesInvariantsTo_span_epsilonContractions {T : (Fin 4 → Fin 2) → B}
    (hT : (suTensor 2).IsEquivariant (fun _ => .fund) ρ (fundMap T)) :
    ReducesInvariantsTo (fun g : SU 2 => ρ g) (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range T))
      (Submodule.span ℂ
        {T ![0, 1, 0, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 0, 1, 0],
          T ![0, 0, 1, 1] - T ![0, 1, 1, 0] - T ![1, 0, 0, 1] + T ![1, 1, 0, 0]})

modules.title: The complex tensor species of `SU(N)`
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The complex tensors of `SU(N)` carry three kinds of index, in analogy with the complex Lorentz
tensors `complexLorentzTensor`: a fundamental index, an anti-fundamental index and an adjoint
index. `suTensor N` is the tensor species with these three colors. The fundamental color is
`Fin N → ℂ` moved by `g`, the anti-fundamental color is `Fin N → ℂ` moved by `(g⁻¹)ᵀ` (for a unitary
`g` the complex conjugate), and the adjoint color is the complexification
`SUAlgebraComplexified N = ℂ ⊗[ℝ] su(N)` of the Lie algebra `SUAlgebra N` of traceless hermitian
matrices, moved by the adjoint representation `adjRep` with the generalized Gell-Mann matrices as
basis, as set up in `LocalGaugeData.SU.Adjoint`. The type of tensors with colors `c₁, …, cₙ` is
written `SuT[N, c₁, …, cₙ]`.

The fundamental and anti-fundamental colors are dual to each other and contract by the dot
product, with unit `∑ eᵢ ⊗ eᵢ`. The adjoint color is dual to itself and contracts by the trace
form `tr (A B)` (`adjContr`), with unit `∑ λ_a ⊗ λᵃ` for the Gell-Mann matrices `λ_a` and their
trace-dual basis `λᵃ =
  λ_a / 2`. In these bases the matrix of `g⁻¹` on each color is the conjugate transpose
of that of `g`, so the colors are closed under adjoints (F) and the general results on equivariant
maps out of the tensors of a species apply. The
species has no metric (`TensorSpecies.WithMetric`): for `N ≥ 3` the fundamental of `SU(N)` is not
self-dual, so there is no invariant in `ℂᴺ ⊗ ℂᴺ` to raise and lower its indices with.

## ii. Key results

- `suTensor.Color` : the fundamental, anti-fundamental and adjoint colors.
- `suTensor.fundRep`, `suTensor.antiFundRep` : the fundamental and anti-fundamental
  representations.
- `suTensor` : the complex tensor species of `SU(N)`, with the notation `SuT[N, c₁, …, cₙ]`.
- `suTensor.isAdjointClosed` : the colors are closed under adjoints, so the general results on
  equivariant maps (`TensorSpecies.IsEquivariant`) apply.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The colors and the carriers
- B. The representations
- C. The contractions
- D. The units
- E. The tensor species
- F. The colors are closed under adjoints

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The colors and the carriers
## B. The representations
## C. The contractions

## D. The units

The unit of a color is determined by its contraction. For a contraction `V ⊗ W → ℂ`, an element
`U ∈ W ⊗ V` is sent to the endomorphism `x ↦ ∑ contr (x ⊗ wᵢ) vᵢ` of `V` (`coevalMap`), and `U` is
a unit exactly when this is the identity. When the contraction separates `W` the map is
injective, so a unit is unique, and it is invariant, its transform being sent to
`g ∘ id ∘ g⁻¹ = id`.
## E. The tensor species

## F. The colors are closed under adjoints

For unitary `g`, the matrix of `g⁻¹` on each color is the conjugate transpose of that of `g`: on
the fundamental color `g⁻¹ = g†`, on the anti-fundamental color `gᵀ = ((g⁻¹)ᵀ)†`, and on the
adjoint color, in the hermitian and orthogonal Gell-Mann basis, the matrix entries are
`tr (λ_a g λ_b g⁻¹) / 2`. So every list of colors is closed under adjoints, and the general results
on equivariant maps (`PhyslibAlpha.Relativity.Tensors.Equivariant`) apply to the tensors of `SU(N)`:
the invariants in the range of an equivariant map out of `(suTensor N).Tensor c` come from invariant
tensors.

declarations.doc: The colors of the complex tensors of `SU(N)`.

inductive Color

  | fund : Color
  /-- The anti-fundamental color. -/
  | antiFund : Color
  /-- The adjoint color. -/

declarations.name: suTensor.coevalMap
declarations.doc: The endomorphism `x ↦ ∑ contr (x ⊗ wᵢ) vᵢ` of `V` attached to `∑ wᵢ ⊗ vᵢ ∈ W ⊗ V`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def coevalMap (contr : (ρ.tprod σ).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ)) : W ⊗[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V →ₗ[ℂ] V

declarations.name: suTensor.coevalMap_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma coevalMap_tmul (w : W) (v x : V) :
    coevalMap contr (w ⊗ₜ v) x = contr (x ⊗ₜ w) • v

declarations.name: suTensor.lid_rTensor_assoc_symm_eq_coevalMap
declarations.doc: The contraction of `x` against the first factor of `U` is `coevalMap contr U x`.
declarations.statement:
lemma lid_rTensor_assoc_symm_eq_coevalMap (x : V) (U : W ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    TensorProduct.lid ℂ V (contr.toLinearMap.rTensor V
      ((TensorProduct.assoc ℂ V W V).symm (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] U))) = coevalMap contr U x

declarations.name: suTensor.coevalMap_injective
declarations.doc: `coevalMap` is injective when the contraction separates `W`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coevalMap_injective [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (h : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.curry contr.toLinearMap).flip) :
    Function.Injective (coevalMap contr)

declarations.name: suTensor.coevalMap_map
declarations.doc:
Transforming both factors of `U` conjugates `coevalMap contr U`, by the invariance of the
contraction.
declarations.statement:
lemma coevalMap_map (g : SU N) (U : W ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    coevalMap contr (TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U)
      = ρ g ∘ₗ coevalMap contr U ∘ₗ ρ g⁻¹

declarations.name: suTensor.map_eq_self_of_coevalMap_eq_id
declarations.doc:
An element whose `coevalMap` is the identity is invariant, when the contraction separates
`W`.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_eq_self_of_coevalMap_eq_id [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (h : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.curry contr.toLinearMap).flip) {U : W ⊗[ℂ] V}
    (hU : coevalMap contr U = LinearMap.id) (g : SU N) :
    TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U = U

declarations.doc: The unit intertwining map `a ↦ a • U` of an invariant element `U ∈ W ⊗ V`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def unitOf {U : W ⊗[ℂ] V} (hU : ∀ g : SU N, TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U = U) :
    (Representation.trivial ℂ (SU N) ℂ).IntertwiningMap (σ.tprod ρ)

lemma unitOf_apply {U : W ⊗[ℂ] V} (hU : ∀ g : SU N, TensorProduct.map (σ g) (ρ g) U = U)
    (a : ℂ) : unitOf hU a = a • U

declarations.name: suTensor
declarations.doc:
The complex tensor species of `SU(N)`, with fundamental, anti-fundamental and adjoint
indices. The fundamental and anti-fundamental colors are dual to each other, the adjoint
color dual to itself.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def suTensor (N : ℕ) : TensorSpecies ℂ suTensor.Color (SU N)
